Hi Samantha — great conversation earlier today. Thanks for walking through the clinical triage use case and the current latency/cost pain youre seeing. Below is a short recap and a proposed 30-day mini-POC we think will validate fit quickly. Please confirm items in bold and any timelines that need to shift.

Summary of what we heard
- Primary pain: excessive inference cost and 3–5s cold-start latency on patient triage flows (peak windows cause user drop-off).
- Secondary constraints: strict PHI handling (need redaction at source), on-prem audit requirements for logs for certain workflows, and strict SLA expectations for peak-hours.
- Success metrics you care about: 30% reduction in per-call cost, 20–30% median latency improvement under normal load, and end-to-end latency <= 1s tail for cached scenarios.

Proposed 30-day mini-POC (high-level)
- Scope: 3 canonical triage prompts (intake, urgency classifier, recommended follow-up) + 10k sample inference events (pseudonymized).
- Owners: Mateo (engagement lead), Ben (runtime configuration & quantization lead), Irene (security & compliance liasion).
- Success metrics & evals: baseline token-cost and latency capture (week 0), weekly prompt evals using the 3 prompt templates (precision/recall on urgency label), and a final performance readout with the 30% cost target and latency distribution charts.
- Access / setup asks (what we need from Astrum):
  - S3 read-only bucket with a 500-record sample (PHI redacted) + schema (CSV/JSON).
  - JIRA or Confluence link to the triage prompt definitions.
  - Security contact for the questionnaire and SOC 2 artifact pull: sec@astrumhealth.com (if different, please share).
- Timeline (tentative):
  - Day 0–3: access + environment spin-up
  - Day 4–10: ingest sample, baseline capture, first prompt evals
  - Day 11–22: runtime tuning (batching/quantization), latency SLO testing
  - Day 23–30: final readout + handoff recommendations

Attachments: mini-poc-charter.pdf (charter + success criteria), access-checklist.csv (fields well need), mutual-action-plan-draft.docx (MVP M A P) — all in the Drive link below.

Immediate asks for Astrum (please reply):
1) Confirm the two stakeholder emails who will approve access and the security reviewer (we listed David Kerr as the infrastructure lead).
2) Share the 500-record redacted sample or grant S3 path + temporary read role by EOD Monday so we can begin Day 0 setup on Tuesday.
3) Are there any org-level PKI/KMS restrictions we should know about for key management?

If this looks good Ill schedule a 45-min kickoff for Wed 11/24 9:00 AM PT and drop a calendar invite.

Thanks again — excited to move fast on this.

Best,
